question.text: Examine the following two structures for the anilinium ion and choose the correct statement from the ones given below

options.text: II is not an acceptable canonical structure, because carbonium ions are less stable than ammonium ions
II is not an acceptable canonical structure, because it is non-aromatic
II is not an acceptable canonical structure, because the nitrogen has 10 valence electrons
II is an acceptable canonical structure

solution.text: II is not acceptable canonical form, because the nitrogen atom has 10 valence electron. Since N does not have d-orbitals in its valence shell, therefore, its octet cannot be expanded.
